dt-api.name: stateRestore.state()

type.description: Retrieves a stored state from the StateRestore extension.
type.parameter: The value that is used to identify a state. This will match the `id` property from `-type StateRestore.State`.
type.returns: Returns a DataTables API instance containing the desired state so that chained methods can be used.

dt-api.description:
This method provides the ability to retrieve a state that is managed by the StateRestore extension.
`-api stateRestore.state()` takes one argument, `identifier`. This string is used to identify the state throughout StateRestore and matches against the `id` property in `-type StateRestore.State`.
The returned object is a DataTables API instance with methods available on it specifically for use to manage the selected state. Please see the related methods below.

example.title: Get all states and then display their details on the console
